$comment: Keys the variant-grouping work needs, to be MERGED into apps/web/messages/{en,ar}.json under the existing `product` namespace. Written here rather than into those files because they were being edited concurrently. `count` and `more` take an ICU {count} argument; the Arabic plural categories matter — Arabic has six, and next-intl/ICU will fall through to `other` for any the message omits, so the forms below are spelled out rather than relying on a bare count.

variants.count: {count, plural, zero {لا خيارات} one {خيار واحد} two {خياران} few {# خيارات} many {# خيارًا} other {# خيار}}
